priorityList: Interrupt with Mind Freeze whenever the target is casting.
Cast Reaper's Mark if Pillar of Frost is ready or will be ready within one GCD.
Cast Pillar of Frost immediately after Reaper's Mark, or on cooldown if Reaper's Mark is unavailable.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa if talented and Pillar of Frost is active and you have at least 60 Runic Power.
Maintain Remorseless Winter at all times, especially during Gathering Storm stacks.
Cast Howling Blast if Rime is active or if Frost Fever is not ticking on your target.
Cast Frostscythe when Killing Machine is active and there are 3 or more targets.
Cast Obliterate when Killing Machine is active if Frostscythe is not available or there are fewer than 3 targets.
Use Frostwyrm's Fury if Pillar of Frost is about to expire or if you have high Strength procs.
Cast Glacial Advance to spend Runic Power and apply Razorice in AoE situations.
Cast Frost Strike if the target has 5 stacks of Razorice and Shattering Blade is talented, or as a secondary Runic Power dump.
Cast Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes or lack a Killing Machine proc while low on Runic Power.
Cast Obliterate or Frostscythe as a filler when you have excess Runes and are not pooling for Reaper's Mark.
Use all offensive Trinkets and Racial abilities during Pillar of Frost.
Pool at least 3 Runes when Reaper's Mark has less than 6 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
